{{Quote|The attacks made by Pendon and his pirates have managed to stop resupply efforts to several bases in the Borderland Regions. It was hoped that by use of heavily armed convoys the pirates could be stopped, but these efforts have failed.|General Airen Cracken|<ref name="wbc">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>}}
The '''Trans-Hydian''', also known as the '''Borderlands'''<ref name="TEA" /> and the '''Trans-Hydian Borderlands''',<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> was an area of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] "north" of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. 

It was contained between the Perlemian and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], traversing slices of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />
==History==
That region of the galaxy was home to [[pre-Republic era|ancient]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and cultures with long heritages and lineages, such as the [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|Sith Empire]] and later the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]].<ref name="TEA" />

The area originally did not experience economic development as [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]] and the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] had. It was burdened with anomalies such as the [[Radama Void/Legends|Radama Void]], and the connection with the Mandalorians and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] brought sheer rumors and fear. However, as development stalled in the Slice and the Trailing Sectors, the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] expanded, and economic development came. Some worlds, such as [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], were established in this area in an effort to protect settlers and investors from various threats. [[Merchant/Legends|Traders]] from Ord Mantell and [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] ignored the shadow of the Mandalorian menace and blazed new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] east of the Hydian, connecting it to the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian]] and its rich worlds.<ref name="TEA" />

The Trans-Hydian was a militarized zone incorporating, among others, the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]], the [[Breago system/Legends|Breago]] and [[Obroa-skai system]]s, [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]], [[Jendorn]], and [[Hettsk]]. Though not an official region or [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Trans-Hydian comprised of vast amount of [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] battle zones.

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Trans-Hydian became known as the "Borderlands" due to its split loyalties between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the remaining [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], prior to the [[Battle of Calamari]] during [[Operation Shadow Hand]], the New Republic received word that fringe worlds in these regions had been [[Attack on the Borderland Regions|attacked]] by monstrous vehicles called "city-smashers" by the survivors. Planet surfaces had been burned away in the Trans-Hydian, and it was later revealed that this had been nothing more than a test of the Empire's new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]], the [[World Devastator]]s.
